mapper.update: UPDATE product SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE product_sku SET deleted = 1 WHERE product_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.category_id, p.product_name, p.sub_title, p.main_image, IFNULL(s.min_price, 0) AS min_price, IFNULL(s.max_price, 0) AS max_price, IFNULL(s.sales, 0) AS sales FROM product p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, MIN(price) AS min_price, MAX(price) AS max_price, SUM(sales) AS sales FROM product_sku WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY product_id ) s ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND (p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.sub_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY s.min_price ASC ORDER BY s.min_price DESC ORDER BY s.sales DESC ORDER BY p.created_at DESC ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.category_id, p.product_name, p.sub_title, p.main_image, p.detail, s.id AS sku_id, s.sku_code, s.specs, s.price, s.stock, s.sales, s.image FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.product_id = p.id AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 1 WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1

SELECT p.product_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM(sales) AS total_sales, product_id FROM product_sku WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY product_id ) s ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1
AND p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY IFNULL(s.total_sales, 0) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT id FROM product WHERE deleted = 0
